title: Give a test after an environment assignment or on a later script line its own uncredited reason and a remedy that keeps the assignment
outcome: A recognised test that gets no check because a literal NAME=value assignment comes before it, or because it sits on a later line of a multi-line script, gets a host line naming that reason. Its one-call remedy does not silently drop the assignment, for example a job throttle.
acceptance: Give a test after an environment assignment or on a later script line its own uncredited reason and a remedy that keeps the assignment is done
